svg.title: Chi-square critical-value table for Q5
svg.desc: Selected upper-tail probabilities, degrees of freedom 1–30. Highlight row 19 and column 0.05: chi-square = 30.144.

g.text: Column α is the upper-tail probability: P(χ² > c) = α
Q5 is a one-sided 5% test: use the upper-tail probability α = 0.05.
Q5: n = 20 → df = 19 → critical χ² = 30.144 (upper 5% tail).
